changes.title: Injury deaths by county first published
changes.summary: CDC deaths from drug overdose, suicide, homicide and firearm injury by year: the nation from 2019 to 2025, and 50 states, DC and 3,142 county areas from 2019 to 2024. The nation's 2025 count, still provisional, is 64,780 drug overdose deaths, 19.3 per 100,000 residents.

source.label: CDC, Mapping Injury, Overdose, and Violence
